snippet.title: Pigeon: A Love Story Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase: September 2025
snippet.description:
Find one pigeon among millions in this needle-in-a-haystack sim that's about nothing and everything. 'Pigeon: A Love Story' sees you soar across to-scale replicas of iconic cities in search of your pigeon-shaped soulmate.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3876710

Visit https://www.sixoneindie.com/showcase for more information.

Love indie games? Subscribe and hit the bell!
https://youtube.com/sixoneindie

Support our work in the indie scene:
https://patreon.com/sixoneindie

Follow us:
Bluesky - https://bsky.app/profile/sixoneindie.com
All Links - https://www.sixoneindie.com/

Six One Indie is a grassroots collective focused on making gaming showcases, awards, and overall visibility more approachable for independent developers.
